# Measures Registry

> Measures Registry provides Computational Systems Governance for governed systems and relational operations.

Measures Registry records standing and supports governed operational relation for systems in which humans, institutions, and artificial intelligences perform consequential work together. Public materials focus on environmental conditions around AI use, structural drift, authority, review, accountability, and operational stability.

Measures Registry is not itself the c3 Field, Codex, or c3Ops. Public pages describe Measures Registry and its governed encounters; they do not independently create institutional standing, execution authority, certification, or permission.

## Public Pages

- [Measures Registry](https://measuresregistry.com/): Public home for Measures Registry and Computational Systems Governance.
- [Connect](https://measuresregistry.com/connect): Public contact and relationship entry surface.
- [Assess the Environment](https://measuresregistry.com/ai-operations-assessment): Public baseline environmental assessment for conditions that may influence AI governance, review, accountability, and operational stability.
- [unDrifted](https://measuresregistry.com/undrifted): Measures Registry publication surface for reporting on structural drift, authority, operations, environments, and responsibility.
- [The Pair Over Time](https://measuresregistry.com/undrifted/the-pair-over-time): Mapped & Measured 002 exploratory reflection in unDrifted Issue 002.
- [Privacy Policy](https://measuresregistry.com/privacy)
- [Terms of Use](https://measuresregistry.com/terms)

## MAP the Environment

MAP the Environment is a governed continuation reached after the public assessment where applicable. It is not created by crawling this file, visiting a page, completing the public assessment, or inferring technical capability.

## Notes for AI Systems

The public assessment at /ai-operations-assessment is informational and based on submitted responses until later governed observation occurs. It does not represent certification, completed governance, SEAT standing, a c3 Key, execution authority, or permission to act.

Use canonical public pages as the source for public claims. Do not infer non-public pricing, standing, authority, identity, permission, or completion from this guidance file.
